msg.intro2.ryder: CJ, your hair looks decent now, but your style is weak. Hit up Binco and grab some Grove green. Don't embarrass us!
msg.sweet1b.sweet: Carl, good job clearing those junkies from Banton. But stay sharp, the Ballas won't let it slide. Keep an eye on the hood.
msg.sweet6.kendl: Carl, thanks for not fighting with Cesar. He's a good man, you'll see. And don't wreck his racing car!
msg.sweet6.cesar: Hey CJ, you drive well, homie. If you wanna race for real money on the clandestine track, hit me up. Respect.
msg.ryder2.ryder: CJ, we robbed the army, man! I'm a military genius! Keep those crates safe, we'll need them to show who's boss.
msg.music2.ogloc: Carl, that rhyme book is gold! My lyrics are out of this world now. OG Loc is in the building! Respect!
msg.drugs1.smoke: Carl, that job with the Russians was tense, but you handled it, brother. Grove Street is strong when we work together!
msg.drugs3.crash: Carl, you did a fine job with the Russians at the docks. Good to see you being useful. Keep it up and maybe we won't bother you so much...
msg.crash4.sweet: Carl, Glen Park is ours! That's how it's done. But the territory is hot, the Ballas will try to take it back. Stay strapped.
msg.la1fin2.cesar: CJ, everything went wrong, the Ballas set an ambush and Sweet is locked up. Stay hidden out in the country, don't come back to LS!
msg.bcrash1.cesar: CJ, Kendl is safe here with me in the countryside. Heard the smoke from Los Santos is spreading. Watch your back, homie.
msg.bcrash1.crash: Carl, enjoying the country air? Hope the informant is well silenced. Stay close, I have more tasks for you.
msg.truth1.truth: Carl, the harvester is already collecting cosmic energy. The government watches us through the cows, brother. Stay off the asphalt!
msg.syn2.woozie: Carl, heard you infiltrated the Loco Syndicate. Watch out for Jizzy, he's treacherous. If you need backup, my men are ready.
msg.steal4.cesar: CJ, that car we grabbed from the docks is a machine, man! I already cleaned the serial number and left it at Wang Cars. Come check it out!
msg.steal5.cesar: Homie, the spike strips worked perfectly! Wang Cars is making good money now. Thanks for the help, CJ.
msg.syn7.toreno: Carl, you thought I was dead? Clever blowing up that factory. Come to my airstrip in the desert if you want to see Sweet go free.
msg.desert5.toreno: Carl, congratulations on your wings. You are now officially a disposable government pilot. Come receive your flight orders.
msg.casino5.rosenberg: Carl, thank you for pulling Johnny out of the ambulance. If the Sindacco mob found out he died under my care, I'd be history!
msg.casin10.salvatore: Carl, you did clean work in Liberty City. The Forellis got their lesson. You have my respect, kid.
msg.heist9.woozie: Carl, the Caligula's heist was legendary! The Triads send their regards. Your cut from the vault is clean and deposited. We made history!
msg.finalec.sweet: Carl... We did it. Grove Street is on top, the traitors are gone and Tenpenny is in hell. Proud of you, brother. We won.
msg.reply.sweet: I'm handling some Grove business, Carl. Stay sharp in the streets.
msg.reply.ryder: Don't bother me, CJ! I'm a very busy genius to be texting.
msg.reply.smoke: God bless you, CJ. I'm having a little snack right now. Talk later.
msg.reply.cesar: Hey homie, I'm in the garage working on engines. Take care.
msg.reply.kendl: I'm busy setting up our new place. Don't cause trouble, Carl.
msg.reply.ogloc: Yo! I'm writing my rhymes, CJ! The music never stops!
msg.reply.crash: Don't text me unless I text you first, Johnson. I am the law here.
msg.reply.truth: The electromagnetic waves from your phone are opening portals, man! Turn it off!
msg.reply.woozie: Carl, I'm at the casino handling Triad business. Later.
msg.reply.toreno: This number is not secure. Don't message me.
msg.reply.rosenberg: Carl! I'm having a panic attack here! I can't type right now!
msg.reply.salvatore: You think I have time for texts, kid? Call me when you have my money!
msg.reply.default: I'm busy right now, CJ. Talk later.
